ModMetaData.name: Harmony 3 Strict Binding Compat (local)
ModMetaData.author: sammael
ModMetaData.description: Local stop-gap fixes for RimWorld 1.7 (Harmony 3, UnityStubs). Remove each one when the mod it covers is fixed. Same list as the README on GitHub. Every C# fix fingerprints the method it touches and logs a red error when that mod updates; XML fixes fail loudly the same way. - Biomes! Caverns (Caveworld Flora): wild fungus colonies regrow (each removed mushroom lowers its colony's count; on load counts are reset to the live mushrooms). - Biomes! Caverns (Caveworld Flora): wild fungi mouseover shows growth again instead of "Brightbells)". - Biomes! Caverns: strips the equipment nodes from BMT_ResourceBlueCrystal ("is equipment but has no verbs or tools"). - Loading Progress: its startup profiler no longer races during parallel XML loading (a mod's defs could fail to load and crash the game into a ModsConfig reset). - Loadout Compositing + Better Workbench Management: per-tag bills get the "count pawns away / on caravan" option back (BWM's new Debug build broke LC's transpiler). - Better Workbench Management: its bill options no longer overlap the "Use global style" dropdown (vanilla classic mode or Style Change Anytime). - Better Workbench Management (personal tweak): previous/next bill arrows drawn 7 px higher, clear of the ingredient filter. - Biosculpter Pod and Neural Supercharger Resize + Vanilla Textures Expanded: a resized biosculpter pod shows its resized icon (not VTE's squeezed 3x2 one) on blueprints and the architect button. - Busywork + LTO Colony Groups: "Upper" job icons show on Colony Groups portraits (Busywork only hooked the vanilla colonist bar). - Catalog Tab + UI Rethemed: the "C" catalog button sits with the other header buttons in the themed inspect pane and info card, and its click works on the info card. - Character Development: the "live in a new settlement" want is fulfilled for the pawns who settle (gravship crew, the settling caravan), not for pawns left on other maps. - Sensible Bed Ownership: OwnedBed answers cached per pawn until bed ownership changes (was rescanning every bed hundreds of thousands of times a minute); spot-checked against SBO; also used by the parallel render threads, and SBO's bed list scan is locked (sleeping animals in animal beds halved FPS, render jobs threw "Collection was modified"). - Hauler's Dream: bulk-hauled loads reach their higher-priority storage instead of going straight back where they came from (no more "bulk-hauled 6 times ... net-zero" loops, food no longer left outside the fridge). - Hauler's Dream + Compositable Loadouts: loadout items are kept during surplus unload again (CL's items now list several defs; HD only knew Item.Def). - Hauler's Dream + Smart Medicine - Continued: Stock Up amounts count as kept even on stacks Hauler's Dream tagged as its own haul (no more unload / re-fetch loop and "Cannot unload inventory" alert). - Hauler's Dream + Kanban Stockpile Continue: HD respects Kanban's max stack size, refill threshold and similar stack limit when it plans pick-ups and unloads into capped storage (no more overfill / remove-excess churn). - Hauler's Dream: bill jobs no longer restart ten times a tick while another pawn carries the ingredient (other pawns' inventory stacks are offered only to batch bills, which can take them). - Hauler's Dream: "Cannot unload inventory" no longer lists downed (anesthetized) or deathresting pawns. - Unique Melee Weapons: an ended warband quest no longer keeps its unspawned raiders in the save (no more "Could not resolve reference ... Ideo_N" warnings on load). - AdaptiveMealBill + Hauler's Dream: batch-cooked adaptive meals come out veg-only, meat-only or mixed by their ingredients, no "Could not recover the meal recipe" error. - IMPACT - Combat Overhaul: its per-shot damage floor is divided by rate of fire for weapons firing more than one shot a second, so rapid-fire weapons (Bulletstorm, miniguns) no longer come out several times above their design; weapons with a third of the tier floor or less of their own (non-lethal dart and tranquilizer guns, pain gun, Beam Witherer) keep their own damage. - Kanban Stockpile Continue: the similar stack limit counts every stack of the same def when accepting, like its remove-excess job does (no more pawns shuttling unmergeable meals between a capped fridge and the next storage). - Kanban Stockpile Continue: a storage holding more stacks than its similar stack limit takes nothing more of that kind until the surplus is hauled out (no more topping up the stack that remove-excess is carrying away). - Kanban Stockpile Continue: with several stacks allowed and a stack size below the item's own stack limit, the later stacks fill up too (a stack already at its size no longer blocks topping up the others). - Kanban Stockpile Continue: remove-excess only offers a job when it can really build one (no "provided target but yielded no actual job" when the destination is already at its own max stack size). - Kanban Stockpile Continue: newly built storage no longer starts with the Kanban numbers of whatever was copied or built last (storage settings without an owner each keep their own, instead of sharing the clipboard slot). - Useful Marks: selected items and buildings show one info card button, not two. - Vanilla Ideology + Alpha Memes (heart extraction): sacrificing an innocent prisoner in a ritual no longer counts as executing an innocent or as a prisoner death through neglect (no opinion / mood penalties for the ideoligion's own ritual). - Common Sense: no "random element from empty collection" warnings for food no recipe makes (meal ingredients lookup skipped). - Common Sense: clean-before-eating moves on when its filth is already gone instead of erroring out of the eating job. - Common Sense: pawns on medical bed rest no longer get up to sweep before lying down (tends no longer fail). - Prisoner Realism + Cleaning Area Relaunched: prisoners only clean filth inside the Clean area, no more standing-still Clean job loop. - Hunt For Me: only player animals take hunting jobs (a released animal marked for hunting no longer hunts itself). - Level Up! (personal tweak): no skill messages for pawns that are neither on a map nor in a caravan (Better Gene Inheritance's throwaway baby pawn announced its skills with the pregnancy letter). - [FSF] Advanced Bionics Expansion + Block Unwanted Minutiae: hediff message comps without message text post nothing (EMP shield implants no longer throw every tick after an EMP hit). - Designator Shapes + Better Architect Menu: flood fill stops at doors again. - Vanilla + VFE Pirates: quest raid previews ("raid of roughly this size:") no longer come out blank; pawn groups whose every pawn costs more than the faction allows at those points are skipped (e.g. the melee-only Junker group). - Vanilla (personal tweak): the Alt cell inspector grows as wide as its longest value, so room stat values show in full with their numbers. - Vanilla Quests Expanded - Ancients (personal tweak): the pneumatic capsule arrival message lists what arrived. - Vanilla Social Interactions Expanded: "cured my friend" thought label resolves for implied relatives (no more template errors or Social tab fallback). - TD Enhancement Pack (personal tweak): the Deteriorating alert leaves out corpses. - UI Rethemed - Animals: hovering a row in a group no longer highlights the same row in the other groups. - UI Rethemed - Info Card + Alpha Prefabs: a prefab box's info card shows its floor-plan picture in the details, under the description. - UI Rethemed - Inspector Tabs: long opinion rows in hover cards wrap instead of overlapping. - Flourish - Everyday Animations: the telescope pose mirrors with the telescope's art, so a West-rotated telescope is used from the eyepiece side too. - Flourish - Everyday Animations: in the telescope pose the telescope is drawn over the pawn and under its hands. - VFE Tribals + UI Rethemed - Factions (visual tweak): the Cornerstones button is drawn as a UI Rethemed button in the themed Factions title bar. - Show Mod Updates + UI Rethemed - Main Bar (visual tweak): the "N updated mods" menu button gets an icon. - UI Rethemed - Main Bar (personal tweak): left- or right-click on the temperature readout toggles the temperature overlay (Heat Map's colours when it is active). - UI Rethemed - Main Bar + TD Enhancement Pack: Shift-click on the speed tile (or a flyout speed) ends the forced 1x slowdown, as TD does on the vanilla time controls. - UI Rethemed - Inspector Tabs + Auto Extract Genes: the Auto-Extract Genes switch is back, in the themed Health tab's Care section. - VFE Pirates: boxed warcasket weapons (on the map or in storage) no longer show an oversized icon. - VFE Pirates + Shelf Stack Logistics: warcasket welding takes its ingredients from the logistics pickup point next to the foundry, like any bill, instead of walking to the depot. - Colony Manager Redux + MSS Tweaks and Fun: loading a save no longer counts as researching a tech, so it stops granting a free reformation point. - Flourish + Muzzle Flash: no double flash; guns with Muzzle Flash art use it, every other gun uses Flourish's flash. - Leo - Events + Biomes! Caverns: the mineral seams cave gets a random Caverns biome. - Vanilla Expanded pipe networks: nothing is hauled onto taps (they hold only their own output, up to their max), and a drain whose tanks are full hands its items to ordinary storage. - VFE Farming: scarecrows no longer error on animals held inside buildings or containers. - Colony Groups and rituals: no more duplicate load ID errors when loading a save. - UI Rethemed - Notifications (visual tweak): the top-left messages are drawn as rows in its bottom-right, middle-right or top-right notification stack, live 30 s, a hovered one stays and shows UI Rethemed's hover card, under a folding "Messages" heading. - UI Rethemed - Notifications + Satellite Minimap (personal tweak): the top-right notification column starts below the minimap instead of under it. - UI Rethemed - Notifications + Alpha Biomes (personal tweak): on the world map the top-right notification column starts below the "Features in this tile:" panel instead of under it. - Satellite Minimap (personal tweak): a "Mechanoids" row under Colonists in the layers menu hides colony mechs and keeps them out of the Colonists count; the 50-dots-per-class cap is raised to 250; the colony's own predator animals count as colony animals, not under Predators; colony animals get their own row, apart from wildlife. - UI Rethemed - Notifications: the days of food tooltip holds still while hovered (re-counts every 5 s, not while hovered). - UI Rethemed - Colonist Card: info rows show tooltips (the whole line) and highlight on hover; the meal ingredients row leaves out the "only stacks with similar meals" note. - UI Rethemed - Architect + Vanilla Plants Expanded (personal tweak): Tilled soil sits in one Orders group with Cancel, Mine and the other orders instead of a group of its own. - UI Rethemed - Architect (personal tweak): long names show on two lines, on the grid cards and in the Details panel header, instead of one line cut with "...". - UI Rethemed - Colonist Card: the guilty icon in the inspect pane header gets its own slot instead of covering another button. - UI Rethemed - Colonist Card + TD Enhancement Pack: the "jump to selection" eye button shows its tooltip on itself, not over another header button. - UI Rethemed - Colonist Card (visual tweak): the status pill names the inspiration ("Inspired creativity") instead of "Inspired". - UI Rethemed - Quests + Quality Colors (Continued) (visual tweak): quest reward tiles and their hover card titles are drawn in the item's quality colour, and the market value sits on the line under the name instead of beside it. - Altered Carbon 2 + Too Many Mods: no NullReferenceException from the Cuirassier belt reload check when Too Many Mods has swapped its VEF shield for the vanilla one (Altered Carbon's belt-charging job is skipped then). - Auto-Cast Specialist Commands + Det's Xenotypes - Stoneborn (personal tweak): Stonecall is auto-cast when mining or finishing construction, following the Auto-Cast Mining Command setting, which right-click on the Stonecall gizmo toggles (check icon shown). - Vanilla (found through Modern Needs Tab): an emptied minified thing has a label again, so job reports no longer throw and MNT keeps recording job history. - Stem's VWE Industrial Expansion, Fortification Industrial - Citadel: missing weapon sounds pointed at existing ones (pistol equip, sawn-off repeater shot, flame bunker). - Smart Medicine - Continued (personal tweak): the Stock Up picker also lists the VRE Sanguophage animal, corpse and sanguophage hemogen packs, packaged survival meals and nutrient packaged meals. - Smart Medicine - Continued: stocked food-type items such as hemogen packs are no longer dropped by the idle inventory cleanup. - Smart Medicine - Continued: the "use nearby medicine" distance setting is measured in tiles, as its label says (it compared walking cost to tiles, so nearby medicine was never used). - Vanilla Psycasts Expanded (personal tweak): enemy psycasters no longer spam Cold zone (NPC autocast off), and the zone's glow is fainter and drawn under pawns instead of whiting out the area. - Vanilla Races Expanded - Sanguophage: animalfeeders (strigoi) drink animal hemogen packs on their own, like regular packs, when no prisoner or regular pack is available. - Hospitality: Vending machines (personal tweak): the powered vending machine draws 100 W and keeps stored items frozen while powered. - Mod Settings Framework (VEF): slider settings reach every def their xpath matches, not just the first (ReBuild's grate speed slider now covers the sterile grate tile). - MSS Tweaks and Fun: haunt portraits no longer saved upside down on 1.7/Vulkan. - MSS Tweaks and Fun (Pondering Orb): its hologram no longer drains neural superchargers or sulks about wanting a supercharge or a body modification it can never get, and others do not think less of it for having no prosthetic. - MSS Tweaks and Fun: the AI core haul work giver no longer asks every colony building for an AI core on a map that has none. - MSS Tweaks and Fun: VFE Pirates Buckoneer culture patch remapped to the VFEP_Mercenaries faction. - Hospitality: Casino: tables given Casino's vending comp by LocalTweaks (tongo, billiards) charge visitors once per game. - Hospitality: Casino: the inspect pane shows the pricing setting and the silver charged per game. - Hospitality: Casino, Vending Machines: the "withdraw earnings" work givers list vending machines without filtering every colony building. - Hospitality: Casino: only casino visitors and trade caravans at their chill spot play slot machines (bestowers, shuttle guards and leaving caravans keep their duty). - Hospitality: visitors in warcaskets skip the arrival re-gear (casket pieces re-locked) and keep their casket helmet on. - Hospitality: guests no longer sleep on the floor after a save is loaded in the same session (stale per-pawn guest comp cache cleared on load). - Hospitality: guests helping out no longer null-ref in the hopper-filling work giver on food outside the guest area. - Giddy-Up 2: dismounted caravan animals keep their travel/follow target, so the caravan arrives and leaves. - Giddy-Up 2: animals rescuing a downed pawn are not picked as mounts. - Giddy-Up 2: an animal the rider may not touch (forbidden, outside the allowed area) is not picked as a mount, so the Mount job no longer restarts ten times a tick. - Goji's Misc Genes + Living Bonds: no Parroting null-ref when a carried baby is talked to. - Vanilla Social Interactions Expanded + Goji's Misc Genes: a Parroting pupil can answer a teaching interaction without a "key was not present in the dictionary" tick exception. - Vanilla/unknown: a caravan guard holding a trader kind counts as the Trader (dismiss works, caravan exits). - Vanilla: visitors and trade caravans no longer leave on arrival "because of dangerous temperature" from hypothermia or heatstroke frozen on them while they were stored as world pawns (it now recovers there at the vanilla off-map rate). - ReplaceLib + Fortifications - Industrial: the lathe's "make component" recipe is no longer removed as a duplicate of the fabrication bench one, so its bills survive reloading. - Vanilla gatherings: the host of any party stays through its own work or sleep schedule until the party ends, and every gathering's called-off message names the reason. - Smarter Visitors + Event Image Popup: the "visitors are about to leave" question shows the visitor-group picture. - Vanilla friendly raids: reinforcements arrive dressed for extreme cold (warmest non-armor apparel their faction can make). - Ritual Size Attenuation + VFE Empire: art exhibit, grand ball and parade no longer crash in the outcome (an art exhibit stuck forever, guests starving). - VEF (MVCF): multi-verb weapons use the weapon's own accuracy/cooldown when the verb sets none; duplicate stat rows hidden; Range row fixed. - VEF: verb range factor applied to the result instead of the shared verb def (no stuck ranges). - Unburned + VEF: drafted pawns with reach melee weapons auto-attack at full reach again (Unburned replaced the method VEF patches). - Alpha Armoury (tesla coil trait) + VEF: tesla chain fire follows vanilla ignition rules (mechanoids no longer burn, one fire per target). - Vanilla (seen with Alpha Armoury's tesla coil): the floating "Adapted" text shows at most once per second per pawn instead of once per EMP instance (dozens per tesla burst). - Vanilla (seen with Alpha Genes plagued shamblers): a hit fully blocked by armor no longer adds its disease at severity 0, so no false "Disease: Shambler plague" letter. - Sensible Bed Ownership: reservation prefix skipped for beds with no map. - Sensible Bed Ownership: no more NullReferenceException from the spouse-sleep thought when a pawn owns a bed that is on no map. - Skilled Refueling: Harmony 3 unchecked binding for its mistyped __instance patch. - Smarter Visitors + Hospitality: its leave-delay prefix only touches Hospitality's stay timer, not the 1200-tick recovery after a fight (hurt visitor groups no longer stand at their defend point forever instead of leaving). - Basic Traits: "TraitHediffApplier: Processing pawn" debug spam removed. - Better Beggars: beggar quests are built on a map where something can be requested, so they no longer arrive asking for nothing when the colony is split across maps. - Triumphant Research: shows the full unlock list instead of a blank window. - Too Many Mods: 22 lowercase "Defs/thingDef[" xpaths fixed (Rimsenal items). - Rimsenal Faction Pack - Spacer: no second style comp on the mech commander helmet, Dresser, EndTable and FloodLight. - Rimsenal - Security Pack (with LocalTweaks): incinerator and graser turrets show their range ring while placing (vanilla ring code null-refs on beam verbs). - Royalty monument quests + VE Framework pipes (personal tweak): VE pipes, visible or hidden, count as power conduits for monument placement and the finished monument. - Pulse Weaponry (and any weapon with the same mistake): weapons with an ability comp no longer also keep the plain equipment comp, so their verbs stop clashing on load. - ReGrowth plant patches: duplicate wild plant records removed from biomes (world-gen Landmarks/Mutators steps). - Vanilla: no needs while no world exists (quest pawns built before the world loads). - Vanilla: shuttle passengers are no longer evicted (and dropped from their lord) on landing because they last left a map more than a day ago; the one-day eviction now counts time spent inside the shuttle. - Vanilla/unknown: trade ship slave also saved as a world pawn no longer loads twice. - Vanilla + GUI Performance Patch + VEF: small psycast/ability buttons on the top row show their tooltips again. - Vanilla: a failing sibling relation no longer aborts a whole raid group (a RimPacts defend wave froze the game retrying it). - Vanilla (personal tweak): install and implant-removal operations get the implant item as their menu icon instead of a grey square. - Vanilla (personal tweak): clicking a plant pot or hydroponics basin selects the grower first, the plant on a second click. - Vanilla + Better Workbench Management (personal tweak): "do until you have X" bills count their products once per bill every 600 ticks instead of on every work scan; finishing an item refreshes the count at once. Loadout Compositing's per-tag bills use the same cache. Colonists arriving on a map refresh every count at once. - Vanilla Gravship Expanded - Chapter 2: the warcomputer search (every 250 ticks per player turret) no longer runs for every turret, only for the gauss gun and gauss howitzer that use its answer. - Vanilla (personal tweak): two tick hot paths made cheap: the "is this comp type sealed" lookup no longer takes a lock, and doors ask "is this pawn hostile" once per pawn per tick instead of once per reachability cache entry. - Vanilla (personal tweak): up to 12 ticks per frame at 3x speed instead of 6, so a slow frame no longer costs ticks (frame rate is traded for tick rate). - Diagnostic (off unless a file ticktrace.on is in the mod folder): logs exact time per phase of the pawn tick, or (file contains "reach") work search time and reachability checks per work giver, plus what the merge work giver searches. - Vanilla + Vanilla Recycling Expanded (personal tweak): the fixed-ingredient search (alloy splitter, trash compactor) no longer walks the whole map when nothing of the wanted kind is on it. - Vanilla (personal tweak): bill work givers with several bench types (cooking, butchering, smelting) search only their own benches instead of reach-checking every pawn, animal and bench on the map. - Vanilla (personal tweak): the merge work giver searches only stacks that have a possible partner stack in their storage group instead of every partial stack in storage. - Vanilla (personal tweak): a reachability cache miss floods the region map once per pawn and room instead of once per destination room; the first 5000 answers of a session are checked against the game's own flood. - Vanilla Odyssey (personal tweak): the gravcore subquest generator no longer walks every quest on every tick; same odds, cheap tests first. - Vanilla Odyssey (+ Gravship Fleet): a leftover "leave ship" / "board ship" job ends once no grav engine lists the pawn, so visitors no longer stand without food or sleep after a gravship launch ritual. - TD Enhancement Pack: the "urgent refill" work scan is skipped while no storage is marked for urgent refill (it searched storage for every haulable item on the map regardless). - TD Enhancement Pack + Altered Carbon 2: the "Empty Workbench" alert skips benches no recipe uses (the neural editor, run from its gizmos). - Altered Carbon 2: the childbirth ritual no longer picks a sleeve casket as the bed for the mother. - 1trickPwnyta's Ideology Patch: big raids no longer freeze the game while raiders are generated (its "Look change desired" check now runs without rebuilding lists of every hairstyle). - VFE Factory: an end-of-line splitter no longer stops the line when the cell it faces holds a building (lamp); it picks a side output first. - VFE Factory + Kanban Stockpile: a conveyor fills the hopper or storage it ends at only up to that storage's Kanban max stack size. - VFE Factory + EPrime's Readouts: the readout also counts what rides on conveyors. - Vanilla colonist bar + LTO Colony Groups (personal tweak): no grey frame behind colonist-bar groups. - Vanilla Plants Expanded - Mushrooms + Biomes! Caverns (personal tweak): redcap, zapcap, foampuffer, toxpuff, lullabloom, glowcap and thermoregulus can be planted in fungiponics basins too. - WOWGAG's Performance Patch: its turret/pawn target reuse no longer asks the runtime for the validator's method on every search (about half of all turret tick time); a small table gives the same answer. - Alpha Books: ruined and burned books show in the reading policy dialog again, so a policy can allow them and colonists read them for recreation (Alpha Books hid them together with its single-use books). - Alpha Books: colonists pick ruined and burned books at random together with novels, instead of only when no novel or useful textbook is left. - (tooling): the previous run's Player.log and Hauler's Dream debug log are copied to Logs/Archive at startup (newest 30 kept). - (tooling, temporary): a job that restarts ten times a tick logs what it points at (job-loop probe). - (tooling, temporary): Loadout Compositing per-tag bills log their target, cached and live count and tagged pawns when they decide to craft and when they finish (per-tag bill probe).
